title: `_view_hypervisor` cyclomatic complexity 21 (61 lines)
detail: `_view_hypervisor` (lines 51–129) has CCN=21 across 61 lines. Each additional branch multiplies test cases needed for full coverage. Fix: extract one or more decision-heavy sub-routines.

title: 8× exception raised without `from` in except block (W0707, first at line 189)
detail: At 8 location(s) (first at line 189), a new exception is raised inside an `except` block without `raise ... from original_exc`. This discards the original traceback and makes debugging harder. Fix: `raise NewExc(...) from exc` to preserve the chain.

title: too-many-branches (R0912) — function(s) at line 51
detail: A function has more branches than pylint's threshold. High branch count multiplies test cases needed for coverage and makes the function a defect magnet. Fix: extract decision clusters into named helper functions.

title: Builtin `id` shadowed by local variable (W0622)
detail: Local variable(s) at lines 326, 342, 386, 440, 480 shadow the builtin(s) id. If the builtin is needed elsewhere in the same scope, the shadowing causes a confusing `TypeError` or silent misbehavior. Fix: rename the local variable to avoid shadowing.
